en.title: Game Points Calculation
en.description:
You are given an array points and a string tokens of the same length. If tokens[i] is T, you gain points[i] points; each pair of adjacent positions that are both T earns 1 extra point. Return the total score. In the original problem, the points/tokens/explanations/answers of the first two examples contradict each other; here the scoring rule is unified according to the source problem's Python, Java and C++ implementations, and the examples were rewritten.

This site's input: 1≤N≤100, 1≤points[i]≤1000, tokens contains only E/T; points and tokens have the same length.

Source: https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/google#65-game-points-calculation (pinned statement fingerprint 2a761527eddb0ae5f7231cac89a2fea7cefa48fd9fb6f693938e01734a619b0c).
en.input: The first line contains N; the second line contains N positive integers points[i]; the third line contains the string tokens of length N.
en.explanation: The total score is the sum of points over all T positions, plus the number of adjacent TT pairs.
hints: Make a single pass; whenever you see T, add that position's points and check whether the previous character is also T.
